title: Speed up full replay planning 19.37x with identical selection
body:
The registered replay planner now indexes changed paths once instead of scanning every changed path for every package. On the same 115,770-path, 3,072-package fixture, three alternating samples reduced the all-tracked median from 47.135 s to 2.433 s (19.37×). Every complete plan, cause list and manifest hash matched. Small-diff timings were approximately unchanged.

This is an algorithmic improvement to verification planning. It does not run fewer checks, change the selected frontier or improve the complete kappa calculation. Selected kappa remains 60403/20000000. The measurement is local macOS arm64/CPython 3.14.7 evidence, not a hosted-CI or multiplication-runtime claim.

Evidence at reviewed commit `7cf7d8774194def41566972aa8003ef3da0fcbbe`:

- [Selection argument, scope and validation](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7cf7d8774194def41566972aa8003ef3da0fcbbe/docs/research/replay-path-index.md)
- [All timing samples and exact-plan hashes](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7cf7d8774194def41566972aa8003ef3da0fcbbe/docs/research/replay-path-index-benchmark.json)
- [Reproducible benchmark](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7cf7d8774194def41566972aa8003ef3da0fcbbe/scripts/benchmark_research_plan.py)
- [Real-Git boundary regression](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7cf7d8774194def41566972aa8003ef3da0fcbbe/tests/test_research_plan_explanations.py)

Base and comparison source: `ff3cc58e370d0f678e529246f8c73e8094e18fcf`. No pending-PR dependency. Input, sparse-inventory, symlink and matrix checks remain active. The checkout must remain stable; the index uses linear temporary storage and no persistent cache.

With Python 3.10+ and the baseline Git history:

```sh
python3 -B scripts/benchmark_research_plan.py --baseline ff3cc58e370d0f678e529246f8c73e8094e18fcf
python3 -B -m unittest discover -s tests -p 'test_research_plan_explanations.py' -v
python3 -I -O -B tests/test_research_plan_explanations.py
```

The benchmark fails on any complete-plan difference. The focused tests report `Ran 7 tests` and `OK`. All 37 relevant tests across plan explanations, replay selection, sparse planning, input paths and matrix batches passed on Python 3.12.13 and 3.14.7; the focused optimized-Python check also passed on 3.12. Selected source-binding orientation and whitespace checks passed. An initial cold-object profiling attempt was stopped and excluded; the later materialized-manifest profile completed. No full historical suite, supplier replay or native Windows run was performed. Hosted CI remains separate.

This refines priority-7 `replay-runtime`; the [scoped Discussion](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5305) records overlap and the stopping test. Final overlap covered 357 open PRs, 4,569 Discussion records and all 7,091 tracked README/TASK notes; canonical main still matched the base. This is not a claim about unpublished work or every diff.

Credit Douglas Colkitt for the [planner](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ff3cc58e370d0f678e529246f8c73e8094e18fcf/scripts/research_package.py), Charles Bethin for the retained [invalidation tests](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ff3cc58e370d0f678e529246f8c73e8094e18fcf/tests/test_research_replay_selection.py), and Tekalign for the retained [explanation and sparse discovery work](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ff3cc58e370d0f678e529246f8c73e8094e18fcf/docs/research/research-package-guide.md), with its Arham-Tahir64 lineage. [PR #1595](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1595) batches source reads; [PR #2958](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2958) rejects incomplete inventories. Those distinct checks remain in place. Source notices are retained. Prepared by @aliromman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance in implementation, measurement, review and documentation; Apache-2.0. No independent human review is claimed.


Publication-time CI update: hosted planning passed at this exact head, but the repository-wide replay is red. Two examined historical jobs fail on stale selected-record pins: [a5-conjugate-5cycle](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39991015391/job/120544366856) and [a5-conjugate-any-registers](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/actions/runs/39991015391/job/120544367007). The latter pins selected-record SHA-256 `bb2eaa58647b353f88d0aec2eafb9d30df1be53589231b23e12ceef3e4bad129`, while the unchanged base record is `6fe0a099b89aa2aed796a13c3a21dafc63f3388ebf397464e44e0451893b9375`. Neither affected package nor the selected record changes in this PR. The only runner change is in `plan_details`; the successful hosted plan and exact plan-equivalence checks remain valid. Other historical failures have not been individually audited. No complete hosted-suite pass is claimed, and no historical evidence is repinned to make it pass.
